map.由导热系数、面积、温差与厚度求热流率: Heat Rate from Thermal Conductivity, Area, Temperature Difference and Thickness
map.输入导热系数 k、面积 A、温差 ΔT 与厚度 d，求热流率。: Enter the thermal conductivity k, area A, temperature difference ΔT and thickness d to compute the heat rate.
map.平壁导热：热流率 = k·A·ΔT ÷ d（W）；联动量：热流密度 = 热流率: Flat-wall conduction: heat rate = k·A·ΔT ÷ d (W); related values: heat flux = heat rate ÷ A (W/m²), thermal resistance per unit area = d ÷ k. Validation: k, A, ΔT and d are required. Criteria: no fixed grading; heat rate is proportional to temperature difference and area and inversely proportional to wall thickness.

map.钢管 k=45、截面积 0.05 m²、温差 60℃、壁厚 0.005 m：Q=: Steel pipe k=45, area 0.05 m², ΔT 60℃, wall 0.005 m: Q=45×0.05×60/0.005=27000 W=27 kW. After 50 mm rubber-plastic insulation (k=0.04), using the same-area flat-wall estimate Q=0.04×0.05×60/0.05=2.4 W, a (1−2.4/27000)≈99.99% reduction. Note: a round pipe should use the cylindrical wall resistance ln(r₂/r₁); this tool is a flat-wall approximation. The insulation outer surface also needs burn/condensation protection.
map.导热系数越小越隔热吗？: Is a smaller thermal conductivity more insulating?
map.是。k 小者单位时间内传热量少，是保温材料核心指标；但注意温度区间与湿度影响。: Yes. A smaller k means less heat is transferred per unit time, the core indicator of insulation materials; but note the effects of temperature range and humidity.
map.稳态和瞬态有什么区别？: What is the difference between steady state and transient?
map.稳态温差恒定、热流不变；开机/季节变化属瞬态，需考虑热容与延迟，工程常用稳态估算: In steady state the temperature difference is constant and the heat flow is unchanged; startup/seasonal changes are transient and require considering heat capacity and delay; engineering often uses the steady-state estimate as the upper bound.
